identity.summary: Understand the fundamentals of generative AI: distinguish between NLP, NLG, and large language models; assess how generative AI differs from traditional AI models and the role of data; and evaluate how generative AI services such as Microsoft Copilot enhance creativity and productivity.

brief.audience: Developers, students, AI engineers, technology managers, and solution architects who are new to generative AI
brief.intended_learning_outcome: Explain what generative AI is, how it differs from traditional AI, and how generative AI services support creativity and productivity

sources.title: Generative AI in a Nutshell - how to survive and thrive in the age of AI
sources.activity_name: Watch Generative AI in a Nutshell
sources.activity_purpose: Build an intuitive mental model of how generative AI works before studying it formally.
sources.activity_instructions: Watch the full video, then write down one analogy from it that explains how a large language model generates text.

sources.title: Explore Generative AI
sources.activity_purpose: Ground your understanding of how generative AI produces language and images and how it differs from traditional AI.
sources.activity_instructions: Complete all nine units including the exercise and knowledge check, then record two ways generative AI differs from traditional AI models.
